trigger.custom:
function(allstates, event)
    local have, name, startTime, duration, icon = GetTotemInfo(2)
    if have and name and name:find("Tremor Totem", 1, true) then
        local interval = 3
        local elapsed = GetTime() - startTime
        local nextIn = interval - (elapsed % interval)
        allstates[""] = {
            show = true, changed = true,
            progressType = "timed",
            duration = interval,
            expirationTime = GetTime() + nextIn,
            autoHide = false,
            icon = icon, name = name,
        }
        if not aura_env.tickTimer or aura_env.tickTimer:IsCancelled() then
            aura_env.tickTimer = C_Timer.NewTimer(nextIn + 0.05, function()
                aura_env.tickTimer = nil
                WeakAuras.ScanEvents("XYREC_TOTEM_TICK")
            end)
        end
    else
        if aura_env.tickTimer then aura_env.tickTimer:Cancel(); aura_env.tickTimer = nil end
        allstates[""] = { show = false, changed = true }
    end
    return true
end

function(a, e, ...)
    if e == "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED" then
        local subevent = select(2, ...)
        local sourceGUID = select(4, ...)
        local spellName = select(13, ...)
        if subevent == "SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS"
                and sourceGUID == UnitGUID("player")
                and spellName == "Windfury Totem" then
            -- arm + start the 10s twist window (WF party buff lingers ~10s
            -- after the totem is swapped away)
            a[""] = {
                show = true,
                changed = true,
                progressType = "timed",
                duration = 10,
                expirationTime = GetTime() + 10,
                autoHide = false
            }
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    -- PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED / PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD: leaving combat disarms
    if a[""] then
        a[""] = nil
        return true
    end
    return false
end

trigger.custom:
function(a, e, ...)
    local currentMana = UnitPower("player", 0)
    local fsrDuration = 5

    if e == "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED" then
        -- attributable mana gain (Mana Spring, Water Shield, potions...):
        -- remember it so it doesn't count as the global regen tick.
        -- "Drink" is deliberately NOT filtered: drink ticks driving the spark
        -- is intended (drink-walking reads the sip timing off this spark)
        local destGUID = select(8, ...)
        local spellName = select(13, ...)
        local amount = select(15, ...)
        if spellName ~= "Drink" and destGUID == UnitGUID("player") and type(amount) == "number" then
            local now = GetTime()
            if aura_env.energizeTime ~= now then
                aura_env.energizeTime = now
                aura_env.energizeAmount = 0
            end
            aura_env.energizeAmount = aura_env.energizeAmount + amount
        end
        return false
    end

    if currentMana >= UnitPowerMax("player", 0) then
        return false
    end

    if e == "UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT" and currentMana > aura_env.lastMana then
        local gained = currentMana - aura_env.lastMana
        local energized = 0
        if aura_env.energizeTime and GetTime() - aura_env.energizeTime < 0.25 then
            energized = aura_env.energizeAmount or 0
        end
        aura_env.energizeAmount = math.max(0, energized - gained)
        -- only a gain beyond recent energizes is the global 2s regen tick;
        -- ignore ticks inside the FSR (Meditation-style partial regen)
        if gained > energized and GetTime() >= aura_env.lastCast + fsrDuration then
            local duration = 2
            a[""] = {
                show = true,
                changed = true,
                duration = duration,
                expirationTime = GetTime() + duration,
                progressType = "timed",
                autoHide = true
            }
        end
        aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
    elseif e == "UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED" and currentMana < aura_env.lastMana then
        local duration = fsrDuration
        a[""] = {
            show = true,
            changed = true,
            duration = duration,
            expirationTime = GetTime() + duration,
            progressType = "timed",
            autoHide = true
        }
        aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
        aura_env.lastCast = GetTime()
    end
    return true
end

check.value:
function(states)
    if states[1].expirationTime and states[2].expirationTime and states[2].duration then
        
        
        local timeLeft = math.abs(states[1].expirationTime - states[2].expirationTime)     
        local ohLeft = states[1].expirationTime - GetTime()
        local mhLeft = states[2].expirationTime - GetTime()
        -- time left in real time until main hand swings
        local wasMH = states[2].expirationTime-GetTime()+0.01 > states[2].duration
        local wasOH = states[1].expirationTime-GetTime()+0.01 > states[1].duration
        -- did we just hit with the off hand?
        local ohBeforeMh = states[1].expirationTime <= states[2].expirationTime
        
        return not aura_env.config["CbM"] and (((timeLeft < 0.5 and ohBeforeMh) and not (ohLeft < 0.5 and wasMH)) or (mhLeft < 0.5 and wasOH))
    end
end
